description: List bounded Preview screenshot evidence for one session. Status is a closed lifecycle: PENDING -> READY (verified, private, retained 14 days) | FAILED (typed code/retryability/remediation; durable) | EXPIRED. Stale PENDING rows sweep to FAILED (STALE_PENDING_EXPIRED) on read — nothing stays silently pending. Requires lms:read.
